run_md_simulation: run a molecular dynamics simulation on a single structure using MDRunner with a thermostat and calculator
save_md_checkpoint: save the MD simulation state including atoms, thermostat, and step count to a checkpoint directory
load_md_checkpoint: load MD simulation state from a checkpoint directory to resume from a previous step
write_md_results: write MD simulation results metadata as JSON including trajectory file, log file, and elapsed time
review_MDRunner_class: review the MDRunner class and its calculate method for running single-structure molecular dynamics simulations
